detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Emergent Preference Formation
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates a new research project focusing on the mechanisms of preference formation within autonomous systems. By investigating whether path-dependent experiences can lead to stable, emergent preferences, the research seeks to understand if intelligence can develop self-consistent decision-making criteria without explicit external instruction, aligning with the current Attention topic.
